column3: ...Doesn't it feel like... Kuroneko-san was acting a bit strange?
I know, right? She was definitely acting strange! You thought so too?
Y-Yeah, it looks like she is... avoiding you on purpose.
Kyou-chan, have you done anything... to Kuroneko-san?
I didn't! Nothing at all! I think...
Then why is she avoiding you like that? I'm sure that there's a reason for it.
Hey, Manami... I want to ask you since I might not have realized it myself... Did I say anything wrong to Kuroneko just now?
You were a very kind senpai just now.
But that was nothing out of the ordinary for you. I think that Kuroneko-san is avoiding you for some other reason.
You're not helping me at all with that!
A reason why Kuroneko would reject me...
I don't have the slightest clue...
How about asking Kirino-chan for advice?
W-What does Kirino have to do with this?
After all, don't Kirino-chan and Kuroneko-san get along really well?
That's why she might know the reason why Kuroneko-san is acting so strange.
...But I'm reluctant to ask her for help.
I can't help it once you call me that.
